name: multiStart
title: Nonlinear Optimization or Root-Finding with Multiple Starting Values

origin.description: Each row of par is a start. action solve calls BBsolve. action optimize calls BBoptim.
origin.usage: multiStart(par, fn, gr=NULL, action=c("solve", "optimize"), method=c(2, 3, 1), lower=-Inf, upper=Inf, project=NULL, projectArgs=NULL, control=list(), quiet=FALSE, details=FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: par
arguments.text: A vector, or a matrix with one start per row.

arguments.name: action
arguments.text: solve or optimize. A prefix that matches one of them is enough.

origin.details: A vector start becomes one row. Converged is true when the solver reports convergence 0.
origin.value: The same list the R function returns for this case.
